curriculum.title: Puppy Pic Web App
curriculum.description: A quick, cheerful HTML mini-course. Learners build one web page, load a puppy photo from the internet, and give it a neat finish.

lessons.title: Simple Page Design with HTML
lessons.body: HTML is the page skeleton. Start with a title, a big heading, and one friendly line.
lessons.avatar_script: First, we build a tiny stage for our puppy app: a title, a big hello, and one cheerful line.

code_example.code:
Puppy Picture App

A puppy page is coming soon.
code_example.explanation: The h1 tag makes the big heading. The p tag adds the friendly paragraph.

questions.question: Which tag makes the big page heading?
questions.explanation: The h1 tag creates the main heading.

questions.question: The p tag adds a paragraph line of page text.
questions.explanation: The p tag adds paragraph text.

questions.question: Write the full starter page for the Puppy Picture App.
questions.explanation: Build it from DOCTYPE to closing html. Add the title, heading, and one friendly line.

code_example.code:
Puppy Picture App

A puppy page is coming soon.
code_example.explanation: This complete page creates a title, heading, and short line.

testCriteria.expectedCode:
Puppy Picture App

A puppy page is coming soon.

lessons.title: Adding a Photo
lessons.body: Pictures use IMG tags. The image link points to the puppy photo, and alt says what is in it.
lessons.avatar_script: Now for the star of the page: the puppy photo. Paste the link, add alt text, and the app comes alive.

code_example.code: Puppy Picture App
code_example.explanation: The IMG tag shows the photo. SRC holds the link, and ALT describes the image.

questions.question: Which tag shows a picture?
questions.explanation: The IMG tag displays an image.

questions.question: SRC is the web address for the picture.
questions.explanation: The browser uses SRC to load the image.

questions.question: Write the full page that shows the online puppy photo.
questions.explanation: Build it from DOCTYPE to closing html. Add the puppy image link inside img.

code_example.code: Puppy Picture App
code_example.explanation: This complete page loads the puppy photo from the internet.

testCriteria.expectedCode: Puppy Picture App

lessons.title: Styling It Up with CSS
lessons.body: CSS dresses the page. Center the text, soften the corners, and keep the puppy photo tidy.
lessons.avatar_script: Final polish: a clean background, centered text, and a puppy photo that fits nicely.

code_example.code:
Puppy Picture App

Say hello to two happy puppies.
code_example.explanation: The style tag adds CSS. The page is centered, bright, and easy to read.

questions.question: Which tag holds CSS on this page?
questions.explanation: The style tag holds the page's CSS rules.

questions.question: CSS can resize an image.
questions.explanation: The width rule can make an image bigger or smaller.

questions.question: Write the full polished Puppy Picture App.
questions.explanation: Use the complete code from DOCTYPE to closing html. Include the CSS, heading, line of text, and puppy photo.

code_example.explanation: This complete page centers the content, styles the background, and shows the puppy photo.
